title: 第9章
content_zh: 第9章 怒闯男寝室的美女所谓适者生存，仅仅三天下来，楚子风已经适应了大学生活。其实，大学的生活是非常枯燥的，也是非常无味的，每天都在做着重复的事情，可如果有点特别的事情发生的话，那几年的大学生活就会变的非常有趣了。下午的课刚完，男生的寝室大楼突然**了起来，不是因为发生了殴斗事件，而是有四个女生不理会寝室大楼的保卫人员硬闯了进来，虽然在燕京大学男生进入女生的寝室，女生进入男生的寝室并不是什么奇事，可现在闯进男生寝室大楼的四个女生全部都是燕大的美女，其中一个还是今年燕大校花榜第三名的吴晓爱，这不得不让所有的男生激动加好奇。“快看，是大三电脑系的吴大美女，她可是今年校花榜的第三名，怎么跑到男生寝室楼来了？”“是呀，我在燕大呆了三年了，还是第一次见吴晓爱来男生寝室楼的。”“难道是来找易天涯的吗？”“不可能，易天涯他们几个又不住学校寝室，而且，从开学到现在他们都还没来过学校。”“那她跑过来找谁呀？”“吴大美女来找谁的我不知道，可看她这怒气冲冲的样子，恐怕是有人要倒霉了！”“那还等什么，跟过去看好戏呀！”寝室楼内每一层的男都议论了起来，而在寝室楼外面，齐白三人刚刚从学校的食堂回来，就听到寝室楼内的声音。“发生了什么事？他们那些家伙叫什么叫呀！”齐白口中叼着支牙签，手里还打包了饭菜，在听到寝室楼内的叫声后停下了脚步。几个男生从齐白三人身边跑过，就听其中一个男生说道：“听说吴晓爱到我们寝室楼来了，快去看美女呀！”齐白三人的脸色顿时一变，吴晓爱来了？该不会是为了昨天校花榜的事情来找麻烦的吧！不对呀，楚子风可是电脑高手，他以黑客技术侵入学校的系统应该不会被发现才对呀，难道是被吴晓爱查出了IP地址！齐白将原本带给楚子风的饭菜往旁边一丢，道：“不好，要出事！”“还愣着做什么！我可听说吴晓爱是出了名的泼辣，如果她真发现昨天的事情是老四干的，还不跟老四拼命！”丁云说完立刻朝寝室楼跑去，齐白二人跟在了后面。楚子风在下课后没有跟齐白他们一起去食堂吃饭，而是趁这个时候一个人呆在寝室里修炼。既然在玄天洞府得到了玄天大帝的传承，那楚子风就不能浪费，如果真能将修为提升到最高境界的话，说不定也能跟玄天大帝一样，来个白日飞升，跑到传说中的神界去玩玩，看看自古相传的神界到底是个什么样子。经过一个多小时，楚子风将体内的真气完全提升了起来，寝室内也出现了一层层微弱的青光，但楚子风的修为却没有丝毫的动静。将真气收回体内，楚子风从床上走下来，站在窗户前，自言自语道：“为什么体内的真气不见涨呢，还是停留在离开玄天洞府的状态？”仔细回想了一下，自己在玄天洞府修炼时是有着“青木帝皇诀”可练的，但现在“青木帝皇诀”已经练成了，难道说，要配合上一种功法才能达到提升的效果吗？“玄天大帝只留下一套功法，虽然这套功法是可以随着我修为的提升而变强大的，可如果没有其他功法修炼的话，我的修为就没办法提升了。”这下可遇到难题了，修真者的功法可不是课本，就算有钱也买不到，没有功法修炼的话，修为就无法提升上去，这叫自己到哪去弄功法呀！正在楚子风烦恼时，突然“砰”的一声，寝室的门被人给踢了开来。楚子风转身看去，面对自己的，是一只又白，又长，又美的腿，四个女生站在了寝室外，那踢开寝室门的美女上身穿着一件红色的无袖紧身衣，下身穿着黑色的牛仔裤，凸显出了她那曲美的身材。“你是不是楚子风？”美女气冲冲的进入了寝室，另外三个美女紧随其后！而在寝室外，顿时间围来了无数的学生，每一个学生都是一副看戏的表情。吴晓爱不但是燕大的美女、校花，同时还是这燕大的大姐大，为人霸道，不将任何人放在眼里，就连校长她也敢骂，招惹上了这种女人，谁也受不了。楚子风都不知道是怎么回事，看着一脸暴怒的美女，说道：“我是楚子风！美女，你找我有事吗？”吴晓爱说道：“楚子风，这一届高考的省状元，只比全国高考状元少三分，从小无父无母，在Z市孤儿院长大，除体育外，各科成绩都是顶级的，精通电脑，懂的三个国家的语言，我没说错吧？”听吴晓爱对自己的介绍，楚子风是云里来，雾里去的，问道：“美女，我好像不认识你吧，你为什么要查我的资料？”“哼，这些资料学校都有。楚子风，我今天来找你只为一件事。”“什么事？”“昨天是不是你侵入学校的电脑系统？”楚子风脸色一变，他可不傻，一个美女突然气冲冲的来找自己，还查到了自己所有的资料，现在还问起了昨天入侵学校电脑系统的事情，加上她长的这么美，难道她是……“别说不是你，我早就查的很清楚了，昨天入侵学校电脑系统的IP地址就是这间寝室的，而在这个寝室的人，除了你之外，其他三个基本上都是电脑白痴。”“呃，昨天的事情其实不是你想的那样，我只是……”“少跟我废话，我不管你有什么理由，我只想知道，昨天是不是你入侵的？”“呃，的确是我，不过……”“是你就可以了。”吴晓爱对身后的三个美女说道：“青青，把寝室门关起来，你们三个给我守在外面，谁也不许进来。”“OK，没问题。不过晓爱，你下手可要轻一点，别搞出人命来了！”“就是。晓爱，你就用你那招新学的‘踢桃腿’教训这小子一顿就是了，别搞死了他。”好吧，怎么现在的美女都有暴力倾向的，动不动就用脚踢，还专踢男人致命的地方！楚子风是这个汗呀，该死的齐白，这都是你们给我招惹来的麻烦，我现在该怎么办呀！总不能对一个女生下狠手吧！
content_en: Chapter 9 The beauty who stormed into the men's dormitory is called survival of the fittest. After only three days, Chu Zifeng has already adapted to college life. In fact, college life is very boring and boring. You are doing repetitive things every day. But if something special happens, college life in those few years will become very interesting. Just after the afternoon class, the boys' dormitory building suddenly burst into flames. It was not because of a fight, but because four girls barged in regardless of the security guards of the dormitory building. Although it was not unusual for boys to enter the girls' dormitory and girls to enter the boys' dormitory at Yenching University, the four girls who broke into the boys' dormitory building now were all beauties from Yanjing University, and one of them was Wu Xiaoai, who was ranked third in the beauty list of Yanjing University this year. This had to make all the boys excited and curious. "Look, it's Beauty Wu from the Computer Science Department, a junior. She is the third on the campus beauty list this year. Why did she come to the boys' dormitory?" "Yes, I have been at Yanda for three years, and this is the first time I see Wu Xiaoai coming to the boys' dormitory." "Are they here to find Yi Tianya?" "No way, Yi Tianya and the others don't live in the school dormitory, and they haven't been there since the beginning of the school year. I've never been to school." "Then who did she come here to find?" "I don't know who Miss Wu is looking for, but looking at her angry look, someone is probably going to be in trouble!" "What are you waiting for? Come and watch the show!" The men on each floor of the dormitory building started talking, and outside the dormitory building, Qi Bai and the other two people just came back from the school cafeteria, and they heard the sound in the dormitory building. "What happened? What are the names of those guys?" Qi Bai held a toothpick in his mouth and packed food in his hand. He stopped after hearing the shouts in the dormitory building. Several boys ran past Qi Bai and the others, and one of them heard one of them say: "I heard that Wu Xiaoai is coming to our dormitory. Come and see the beauty!" The expressions of Qi Bai and the others suddenly changed, Wu Xiaoai is here? Could it be that they are looking for trouble because of the school beauty list yesterday? No, Chu Zifeng is a computer expert. His hacking skills into the school's system should not be discovered. Could it be that Wu Xiaoai found out the IP address! Qi Bai threw aside the meal he originally brought to Chu Zifeng and said, "No, something is going to happen!" "Why are you still standing there! I heard that Wu Xiaoai is famous for being aggressive. If she really found out that the fourth child did what happened yesterday, she wouldn't fight the fourth child!" After Ding Yun finished speaking, he immediately ran towards the dormitory building, and Qi Bai and the others followed behind. Chu Zifeng did not go to the cafeteria with Qi Bai and the others to eat after class, but took advantage of this time to stay in the dormitory to practice alone. Since he had received the inheritance from Emperor Xuantian in Xuantian Cave Mansion, Chu Zifeng could not waste it. If he could really improve his cultivation to the highest level, he might be able to ascend like Emperor Xuantian during the day and go to the legendary God Realm to see what the God Realm passed down from ancient times was like. After more than an hour, Chu Zifeng completely raised the energy in his body, and layers of faint green light appeared in the bedroom, but there was no movement in Chu Zifeng's cultivation. Taking the true energy back into his body, Chu Zifeng walked down from the bed, stood in front of the window, and said to himself: "Why does the true energy in the body not rise, or is it still in the state of leaving Xuantian Cave?" After thinking about it carefully, he had the "Aoki Emperor Technique" to practice when he was practicing in Xuantian Cave Mansion, but now that he has practiced the "Aoki Emperor Technique", does it mean that he needs to cooperate with the previous technique to achieve the improvement effect? "Emperor Xuantian only left a set of exercises. Although this set of exercises can become more powerful as my cultivation level improves, if I don't practice other exercises, my cultivation level will not be improved." Now we are encountering a problem. The exercises for cultivators are not textbooks. Even if you have money, you can't buy them. If you don't practice the exercises, your cultivation level cannot be improved. Where can I get the exercises? When Chu Zifeng was worried, there was a sudden "bang" and someone kicked open the bedroom door. Chu Zifeng turned around and saw that what faced him was a pair of white, long, and beautiful legs. Four girls were standing outside the dormitory. The beauty who kicked open the dormitory door was wearing a red sleeveless tights on her upper body and black jeans on her lower body, which highlighted her beautiful figure. "Are you Chu Zifeng?" The beauty entered the dormitory angrily, followed by three other beauties! Outside the dormitory, countless students suddenly gathered around, each of them looking like they were watching a show. Wu Xiaoai is not only the beauty and school belle of Yan University, but also the eldest sister of Yan University. She is domineering and doesn't take anyone seriously. She even dares to scold the principal. No one can stand if she messes with such a woman. Chu Zifeng didn't know what was going on. He looked at the angry-looking beauty and said, "I am Chu Zifeng! Beauty, do you have a problem with me?" Wu Xiaoai said, "Chu Zifeng, the provincial number one in this college entrance examination is only three less than the number one in the national college entrance examination. "He grew up without a father or a mother. He grew up in an orphanage in Z city. Except for physical education, his grades in all subjects are top-notch. He is proficient in computers and understands the languages ​​of three countries. Am I right?" Listening to Wu Xiaoai's introduction to him, Chu Zifeng came from the clouds and mist. He went there and asked: "Beauty, I don't think I know you, why do you want to check my information?" "Huh, the school has all this information. Chu Zifeng, I came to you today just for one thing." "What's the matter?" "Did you invade the school's computer system yesterday?" Chu Zifeng's expression changed. He was not stupid. A beautiful woman suddenly came to him angrily, and found all his information. Now she also asked about yesterday's intrusion into the school's computer system, plus she looks so good.
